$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$src='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\screenshots\job-20260929T155945Z-gui-screenshot-01.png'
$dst='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\screenshots\job-20260929T155945Z-gui-screenshot-01-small.jpg'
$img=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($src)
$bmp=New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap 960,540
$g=[System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
$g.DrawImage($img,0,0,960,540)
$jpg=[System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders() | Where-Object {$_.MimeType -eq 'image/jpeg'} | Select-Object -First 1
$enc=New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters 1
$enc.Param[0]=New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter ([System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality),70L
$bmp.Save($dst,$jpg,$enc)
$g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose(); $img.Dispose()
Get-Item $dst | Select-Object FullName,Length | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
